issues.detail: The Greek 'απο του μη εχοντος' (from the one who does not have) is rendered as 'cất luôn điều họ đang có' (take away what they already have). This is a logical reversal: the Greek says the one who *has* will receive from the one who *does not have*, but the Vietnamese implies the one who *does not have* is losing something they already possess.
